Troubleshooting · 13/50 · capture

Audio and picture timecode drift

Failure signal

A audio and picture timecode drift condition is reported or detected during capture.

Likely cause

The controlling record, technical state or approved specification for capture does not match the current asset or workflow.

Verification

Measure offset at the head and tail to distinguish fixed offset from clock drift.

Corrective action

Correct with the verified sync reference and document any time stretch.

Prevention

Add this verification to the capture gate, retain immutable evidence and assign one accountable owner.
